newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Miwon says to sell 104,700 own shares.
newsitem.headline: Miwon says to sell 104,700 own shares.

text.p: Miwon Commercial said on Tuesday it would sell 104,700 of its own common shares between December 6 and March 5 to raise operating funds.
Shares would be sold on the Seoul stock exchange at the closing price of the previous trading day.
Miwon Commercial would hold 5,000 of its own common shares after the sale, a company statement said, reducing the company's ownership of its own shares to 0.31 percent from 6.85 percent.
Hyundai Securities and Hanjin Investment and Securities will arrange the sales.
